cases.B4: PASS: a THREAD read that fails on one message is 'one tied to a row', so the try stays. The row goes try 1, 2, 3, then stuck, and W passes it. During an outage, 'a run ending Failed on a quota, rate-limit or 5xx error, not one tied to a row, first removes its own try lines', so healthy rows aren't marked stuck. Note: a 5xx that only that one message triggers is left to the model to classify as tied to a row. The wording favours that reading.
cases.S-J1: PASS: 'you add its id to your record's body line "stamped: <ids>" as you stamp it'. If the run crashes later, the ids already written survive. Residual: the window between the two writes, stamping the row and then listing it, is one call wide. Writing the id first would close it. Optional.
cases.S-J2: PASS: actions now reads 'each run:inbox-capture: record created since W minus 24 hours'. A stamped row left at try 1 is taken again in later runs until it's done or reaches 3 and becomes stuck. The cost is reading about 24 record lines per run.
cases.prefix: PASS: there's now one rule in all three places. Capture STEP 0: 'an Email out whose Summary starts "Zoya" is hers: add nothing'. Capture STEP 1: 'never a Kind Email out row whose Summary starts "Zoya"'. Actions: closed n/a, 'an Email out whose Summary starts "Zoya" (her row, her routine works it)'. Capture's loop-in ('Akshay to X: Zoya loop-in') and Akshay's mail logged by Zoya ('Akshay to ...') don't match it. The 6c gate's 'Zoya sent: <template>' lookup still works, because it reads rows and doesn't work them.
cases.A1: PASS: unchanged; the stamped: join now covers 24 hours.
cases.D1_to_D9: PASS: nothing changed outside the four edits.
cases.size_emdash: PASS: capture is 35,848 bytes and actions-v2 39,354 (646 bytes to spare). No U+2014.

N1_stamp_order.fix: Optional: 'add its id to the stamped: line first, then the capture: line'.

verdict: Accepted on replay. B4, S-J1, S-J2 and the prefix check pass, and the regression pass over R1 to R4, A1, B1 to B10, S1 to S9 and D1 to D9 is clean. One optional nit remains: put the id on the stamped: line before stamping the row. Preconditions: enable capture on 2 Nov JST or later, paste sections 6 to 8 and read them back before actions is enabled, and watch actions' 646 bytes of headroom.
